units.translation: [with aorist ἐπυθόμην [I learned], perfect πέπυσμαι [I have learned], future πεύσομαι [I will learn], taken from the form πεύθομαι [I learn]. Wrongly πευσεῖσθαι [to be about to learn] at Pr. 988, where πεύσεσθαι [to be about to learn] has been restored from the copies, as elsewhere πεύσομαι πεύσεται πεύσεσθε [I will learn, he will learn, you will learn] is written. For Attic poets did not use that Doric future form οῦμαι [I will] for ομαι [I will] unless the meter demanded it: about which I have spoken in the Oxford annotation on Arist. Ach. 203.] I learn.
(The second person is consistently written πεύση [you will learn] in M.)
